properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 31 at 1:52PM MDT until August 31 at 4:45PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Silver King Burn Scar in...
Northwestern Piute County in central Utah...

* Until 445 PM MDT.

* At 152 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain over the Silver King Burn Scar.
Between 0.5 and 0.75 inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly. Excessive rainfall over the
burn scar will result in debris flow moving through the Bullion
Canyon, Beaver Creek Canyon, and Deer Creek Canyon drainages. The
debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and other loose
materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Silver King Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Silver King Burn Scar.
properties.instruction:
Intense rainfall is falling over the Silver King burn scar,
particularly Beaver Creek. Flash flooding and debris flows initiating
within Bullion Canyon, Beaver Creek Canyon and Deer Creek Canyon are
expected to travel downstream impacting portions of the city of
Marysvale, and US 89 between mile posts 179 and 184.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 4:45 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 4:45 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 31 at 1:48PM MDT until August 31 at 4:45PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Garfield County in southern Utah...

* Until 445 PM MDT.

* At 148 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across Pine Creek Box Canyon, likely resulting in water
moving downstream through Upper Escalante River Canyon. Up to 0.5
inches of rain have fallen on top of heavy rain that fell earlier
today. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks, streams, slot
canyons, and normally dry washes.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Pine Creek Box Canyon and Upper Escalante River Canyon.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 31 at 12:15PM MST until August 31 at 2:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 1215 PM MST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
0.5 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts
up to 0.5 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Tucson, Marana, Sahuarita, Green Valley, Davis-Monthan Air Force
Base, Casas Adobes, Drexel Heights, Flowing Wells, Corona De
Tucson, South Tucson, Three Points, Avra Valley, Pascua Pueblo
Yaqui Reservation, Tortolita, East Sahuarita, San Xavier Community,
Valencia West, Summit, Tucson Estates and Tucson International
Airport.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 19 between mile markers 31 and 63. Route 86 between mile
markers 146 and 171. Route 77 between mile markers 70 and 74.
Interstate 10 between mile markers 233 and 275. Route 286 between
mile markers 25 and 45. Route 83 between mile markers 42 and 45.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Manville Rd at Brawley Wash, Country Club Rd at Franco Wash, Houghton
Rd from I-10 & Sahuarita Rd, Santa Clara Ave at El Vado Wash, 1st Ave
north of Fort Lowell Rd, Stone Ave at Mabel St, Sahuarita Rd west of
Wilmot Rd, Twin Peaks Rd between Sanders and Sandario, Silverbell Rd
near Ina Rd, Camino De La Tierra at the Rillito River, Camino de
Oeste from Sweetwater to Gates Pass, Drexel Rd east of Alvernon Way,
Ironwood Hills Dr from Shannon to Camino de Oeste, Mark Rd from
Jeffery Rd to Los Reales Rd, Mission Rd from Valencia Rd to San
Xavier Rd, Old Vail COnnection Rd at Franco Wash, Sunset Rd west of
Camino de Oeste and Black Wash at S Camino de Oeste.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Brown Wash, Santa Cruz River, Rillito River, Box Canyon Wash, Seco,
Arroyo, Cienega Creek, Banner Wash, Sopori Wash, Bolas Blancas
Wash, Alambre Wash, Soto Wash, Pantano Wash, Thomas Canyon Wash,
Guild Wash, Little Thomas Wash, Robles Wash, Los, Saucito Wash,
Demetrie Wash, Arivaca Creek, Oro, Caada del, South Mendoza Wash,
West Branch Santa Cruz River, Mendoza Wash, Blanco Wash,
Champurrado Wash, Altar Wash, Peitas Wash, Fresno Wash, Cerro
Prieto Wash, Chico, Arroyo, Gardner Canyon, Old Junction Wash,
Fortynine Wash and Brawley Wash.
